items.title: Fred Minor Interview, 1961-11-01
items.q: Just like I said, Irene Lee Hawley was an exceptional good man.

ctx.x: Who would you say would be your very favorite banjo if you had to pick one of all times? If you ever heard, if you don't mind, I don't want to put you on the spot because it's one of the good.
Well, like I said, during that time, I don't know who could play the best banjo because all of them was good during them times. Just like I said, Irene Lee Hawley was an exceptional good man.
He's still living out in California. California.
